2607.26497.title: BM25 Wins at Scale: A Scaling Study of Retrieval-Augmented Generation Paradigms
2607.26497.paper_summary: Retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) spans lexical and dense retrieval, graph-based indexing, and agentic search, but these paradigms are usually evaluated on different benchmarks at one corpus size, leaving their accuracy-cost scaling unclear. To bridge this gap, we present a controlled study that varies corpus size along 28 strictly nested tiers spanning roughly 450-fold, while holding questions and a fixed bedrock of relevant and adversarial documents unchanged. Under one reader model and one judging protocol, we measure official accuracy, construction and query tokens, and latency. The results reveal a scale-dependent crossover rather than an unconditional winner. File-System Agent leads at the smallest shared tiers, but its sequential exploration costs 39 times more query tokens at the bedrock and becomes less effective as the search space grows. Around 10 million corpus tokens, BM25 overtakes it and leads at every larger shared tier, with a margin approaching 20 points at full scale. BM25 also anchors the low-cost end of the Pareto frontier without LLM-based construction. Dense retrieval remains efficient but less accurate, whereas graph-based RAG encounters construction walls before deployment scale and its scalable variants remain below BM25 at shared tiers. Overall, corpus growth increasingly favors global candidate ranking: lexical retrieval is the strongest scalable default, while agentic reasoning works best after ranked discovery rather than in place of it.
2607.26497.paper_summary_zh: 檢索增強生成（RAG）涵蓋了詞彙和密集檢索、基於圖的索引以及代理搜索，但這些範式通常在不同的基準上以單一語料庫大小進行評估，導致其準確性與成本的比例不明。為了填補這一空白，我們提出了一項控制研究，變化語料庫大小，涵蓋28個嚴格嵌套的層級，範圍大約為450倍，同時保持問題和固定的相關及對抗文檔不變。在一個讀取模型和一個評判協議下，我們測量官方準確性、構建和查詢標記，以及延遲。結果顯示出一個依賴於規模的交叉，而不是無條件的勝者。文件系統代理在最小的共享層級中領先，但其順序探索在基石上需要39倍的查詢標記，並且隨著搜索空間的增長效果變得不佳。在約1000萬語料庫標記時，BM25超越了它並在每個更大的共享層級中領先，與全規模相比接近20點的優勢。BM25還在沒有基於LLM的構建的情況下，穩固了帕累托邊界的低成本端。密集檢索仍然高效但準確性較低，而基於圖的RAG在部署規模之前遇到了構建障礙，其可擴展變體在共享層級中仍低於BM25。總體而言，語料庫的增長越來越有利於全球候選排名：詞彙檢索是最強的可擴展默認，而代理推理在排序發現後效果最佳，而不是取而代之。
